target.title: feat: add Grok Build ACP agent
target.body:
## Summary

This replaces the earlier docs-only direction with the implementation path: Grok Build is now a real ACPX built-in agent.

Changes:
- add `grok-build` to the built-in agent registry as `grok agent stdio`
- add Grok-specific auth selection for ACP clients:
  - `cached_token` is treated as Grok agent-managed auth for `grok agent stdio`
  - `XAI_API_KEY` is accepted only for Grok Build when the ACP auth method advertises `xai.api_key`
  - existing OpenAI auth behavior is unchanged
- add focused registry/client/integration coverage
- update docs and the ACPX skill docs to list Grok Build as a supported built-in

## Why

The previous docs-only approach was the wrong shape for this integration. Grok Build should be selectable as a first-class ACPX built-in, not only mentioned in downstream OpenClaw docs.

## Validation

Fresh local proof:

- `./node_modules/.bin/tsgo.cmd -p tsconfig.test.json`
- `node --test dist-test/test/agent-registry.test.js dist-test/test/client.test.js`
- `node --test --test-name-pattern "grok-build" dist-test/test/integration.test.js`
- `./node_modules/.bin/tsgo.cmd --noEmit`
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt.cmd --check src/acp/client.ts test/client.test.ts src/agent-registry.ts test/agent-registry.test.ts test/integration.test.ts README.md agents/README.md agents/GrokBuild.md docs/agents.md docs/index.md docs/install.md docs/2026-02-17-agent-registry.md skills/acpx/SKILL.md`
- `./node_modules/.bin/markdownlint-cli2.cmd README.md docs/**/*.md examples/flows/**/*.md`
- `node scripts/build-docs-site.mjs`
- normal commit hook ran successfully, including lint-staged, oxlint, and tsdown build

Autoreview:

- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --engine codex --model gpt-5.5 --thinking high --json-output .scratch/autoreview-grok-build-acpx-local.json`
- result: `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`, overall `patch is correct (0.79)`

Proof level: `test_proven` for registry/auth resolution and ACPX command wiring. I did not run a live Grok CLI session from this Windows workspace, so this PR does not claim `runtime_proven` Grok execution.
